tab.ended: The machine is not connected. Connecting again opens the workbench with it.

desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.iconUnavailable: This icon cannot be opened on this session.

shortcut.title: New shortcut
shortcut.message: A directory path on this machine. The shortcut opens the file browser there.
shortcut.invalid: Type a directory path. It cannot be empty and cannot carry control characters.

power.title: Power
power.rebootMessage: The machine runs its own restart command. Every connection to it — this one included — goes down with it, and whatever is running there is stopped.
power.shutdownMessage: The machine runs its own shutdown command. Every connection to it — this one included — goes down with it, and whatever is running there is stopped.
power.issued: The command was issued. The machine may disconnect at any moment.

trash.title: Trash
trash.name: Name
trash.cannotRestore: Where this came from is unknown, so it cannot be put back
trash.emptied: Emptied the trash: {count} item(s) deleted for good.
trash.emptyHint: Files deleted into the trash are listed here until they are put back or deleted for good.
trash.emptyMessage: Every entry ({count}) is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
